'''Ibrella''' is a [[novice]] in [[Salidar]].

==Strength==
Her potential is {{opsl|20}}, which is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very strong]] by Aes Sedai standards, as strong as [[Sheriam Bayanar|Sheriam]].{{ref|{{Twotc}}, Ibrella|Ibrella}} As with all Tower initiates, she would not achieve her full strength for several years to come.

== History ==
Ibrella was born in {{ne|980}} in a village a few days' travel from Salidar.{{ref||Ibrella}}

== Activities ==
She is recruited by the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] in Salidar in {{ne|999}} after Elayne and Nynaeve reached them. 

She tried to see how big a flame she could make during [[Elayne]]'s class and nearly set the whole class on fire.{{ref/book|6|13}}

Presumably still alive, she would have joined the rest of the novices in [[Mayene]] to aid with [[Healing]] during [[Tarmon Gai'don]].
